items.calibration: In, Sn, Bi, Zn, Al, Ag, Au and Ni (TA Instruments-Waters LLC)
items.quote: Thermal analysis measurements of the annealed and ascast alloys were investigated in Al2O3 crucibles under a flowing pure Ar atmosphere using differential scanning calorimeter (DSC, Netzsch STA 449 F3) and differential thermal analysis (DTA, TA Instruments SDT/Q-600) at different heating and cooling rates of 5 and 10 K min-1, respectively. Thermal analysis measurements were calibrated using calibration materials In, Sn, Bi, Zn, Al, Ag, Au and Ni (TA Instruments-Waters LLC) as standard samples in order to eliminate the random errors and systematic errors. The overall uncertainty of the determined phase transformation temperature was estimated to be ±1 K.

items.quote: Thermal analysis measurements of the annealed and ascast alloys were investigated in Al2O3 crucibles under a flowing pure Ar atmosphere using differential scanning calorimeter (DSC, Netzsch STA 449 F3) and differential thermal analysis (DTA, TA Instruments SDT/Q-600) at different heating and cooling rates of 5 and 10 K min-1, respectively. Thermal analysis measurements were calibrated using calibration materials In, Sn, Bi, Zn, Al, Ag, Au and Ni (TA Instruments-Waters LLC) as standard samples in order to eliminate the random errors and systematic errors. The overall uncertainty of the determined phase transformation temperature was estimated to be ±1 K.

Experimental Nd (99.99 % purity) and Mn (99.99 % purity) were used as the starting materials. Ingots with the mass of about 3 g were melted three times in an arc furnace by arc-melting pure elements using a nonconsumable tungsten electrode under an inert argon atmosphere.
